text:
nina_sec: flagging an odd case from this morning: SAST reported a critical in service-auth that blocked a deploy. CI artifacts show the job decrypted secrets and proceeded, but Cloud Audit Logs have no KMS Decrypt entry for the service account that ran the job. we need to tighten the suppression/evidence workflow so security can approve safely.
omar_dev: i pulled the CI logs. decrypt failed once then retried and succeeded ~12s later. logs:```\n2026-03-22T08:14:02Z ERROR decrypt: permission denied\n2026-03-22T08:14:14Z INFO retrying decrypt\n2026-03-22T08:14:16Z INFO decrypt ok\n```\nomar_dev: the job gets ephemeral creds from keystore-proxy with TTL=30s.
felix_sre: TTL=30s is tight for audit propagation. audits can take a few seconds to appear; also if grant creation and decrypt happen almost simultaneously the logging backend may not surface the Decrypt event in the expected window.
nina_sec: two concrete asks: (1) adjust the pre-merge suppression flow so that any SAST-critical that would be auto-suppressed requires an accompanying KMS Decrypt audit entry for the decrypting principal, otherwise it becomes a security-approved exception, (2) ensure the CI emits a structured trace marker before decrypt so we can correlate trace->audit entry.
omar_dev: implementation sketch for the GH Action post-step: sleep 30; then run:
```\ngcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.crypto.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="ci-deploy@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" AND timestamp>="2026-03-22T08:14:00Z"' --limit=1 --project=redwood-prod --format=json\n```\nif empty, set a check named "sast-kms-audit" to failure and attach logs to the check.
felix_sre: prefer setting the check to "action_required" instead of hard fail: change PR status to require a security approver to click through after reviewing the gcloud output. reduces noisy interruptions for devs.
audit-bot: [auto] created SEC-799: "sast suppression: require KMS decrypt evidence or security approval" assigned to @nina_sec. link: https://github.internal/redwood/sec/SEC-799
nina_sec: i'll take SEC-799. infra needs to (A) increase keystore-proxy deploy grants to 5m TTL for deploy flows and (B) grant the ci-audit-reader SA minimal cloudkms.viewer so it can query audit logs without owner perms. also request logging retention >=90d.
omar_dev: i'll add the trace shim and the GH Action change. will implement exponential backoff on decrypt with jitter to avoid tight races.
felix_sre: i'll add a smallmetric (sast_missing_kms_audit_total) to watch for regressions after rollout. if it spikes we'll roll back TTL change or tune timing.
nina_sec: perfect. i'll update SEC-799 with the checklist and the runbook text for security oncall: steps to triage missing decrypt evidence, escalation contacts, and where to find the GH check payload. will follow up with PRs today. :white_check_mark:
